title: The Vancura position
line: Against a rook pawn, attack it from the side.

steps.text: White has a rook pawn, and the white rook stands in front of it. Your rook attacks the pawn from the side. This is the Vancura position.
The white rook is tied to the pawn. Your king waits on g7, and the game is a draw.
Set it up: put your rook on the pawn's row, attacking it from the side.

also.f2f3: That check holds too. This lesson goes straight to the pawn's row.

wrong.f2a2: The white king takes the rook.
wrong.f2f1: That loses: from there the rook does not attack the pawn.
wrong.f2f4: That loses: from there the rook does not attack the pawn.
wrong.f2f5: That loses: from there the rook does not attack the pawn.
wrong.f2f7: That loses: from there the rook does not attack the pawn.
wrong.g7h7: That loses: the rook must reach the pawn's row first.

steps.hint: Go up the file to the row the pawn stands on.
steps.after: The rook attacks the pawn from the side, and the white rook must stay to guard it.

steps.text: The white king comes toward your rook. Slide the rook away from it, along the same row.

wrong.d6c6: That loses: the rook is too close to the white king, which walks up to its pawn and frees its rook.
wrong.d6b6: That loses: the rook is too close to the white king, which walks up to its pawn and frees its rook.
wrong.d6d4: That loses: the rook is too close to the white king, which walks up to its pawn and frees its rook.
wrong.d6g6: That loses: your own king on g7 is in the way of the rook's checks along the row.
wrong.d6h6: That loses: your own king on g7 is in the way of the rook's checks along the row.
wrong.d6d7: That loses: from there the rook does not attack the pawn.
wrong.g7h7: That loses: here your king must stay on g7.
wrong.g7f7: That loses: here your king must stay on g7.
wrong.g7g6: That loses: here your king must stay on g7.

steps.hint: Stay on the pawn's row, out of the king's reach.
steps.after: Far from the king, the rook keeps attacking the pawn.

steps.text: The pawn is one step from promoting. Now go behind it.

also.d6b6: That check holds too. This lesson goes behind the pawn.

wrong.d6d7: That loses: the white rook gives itself up with check on g8, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.d6e6: That loses: from there the rook does not attack the pawn.
wrong.d6f6: That loses: from there the rook does not attack the pawn.
wrong.d6c6: That loses: the white rook gives itself up with check on g8, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.g7h7: That loses: here your king must stay on g7.
wrong.g7f7: That loses: here your king must stay on g7.

steps.hint: The pawn's file, below the pawn.
steps.after: If the white rook leaves the corner, your rook takes the pawn. The game is a draw.

summary: Against a rook pawn with the enemy rook in front, attack the pawn from the side, and go behind it when it steps up.
